intro.title: Where the Ionian breeze begins
intro.p1: Cape Avra sits on the cape of Mytikas, five kilometres from Preveza, where the land ends and the Ionian opens up. A wide garden of palms, agaves and shade trees runs to the garden wall. Beyond it lie the beach and the open sea.
intro.p2: In the evening the sun sets into the water and the mountains of Lefkada turn blue on the horizon.
intro.p3: Avra (αύρα) is the Greek word for the soft breeze that comes in off the sea on summer afternoons. It gave the house its name.
intro.caption: Lefkada on the horizon, seen from the upper floor.

sea.title: Front row on the Ionian
sea.text: The house looks straight out to open water. Swim at the beach below, then watch the light change from the garden.

garden.title: A garden for long days
garden.text: A wide lawn with palms and agaves, shade under the pergola and room for everyone. Dinner outdoors, with the sea just beyond the wall.

privacy.title: Yours alone
privacy.text: One house, one group of guests. No shared spaces, no strangers at the next table. Just your own garden and your own gate to the sea.

location.title: On the cape of Mytikas
location.text: A quiet stretch of Ionian coast just north of Preveza. The long sandy beach of Monolithi runs north from here, and the ruins of ancient Nikopolis are a few minutes inland. Lefkada and Parga are easy day trips.

below.title: The beach below the house
below.text: A few steps from the garden. Like every beach in Greece it is public, and outside high summer it is usually quiet.

monolithi.title: Monolithi
monolithi.text: A long sandy beach that runs north from Mytikas for kilometres, with clear water and room for everyone.

lefkadaWest.title: Lefkada's west coast
lefkadaWest.text: Porto Katsiki, Egremni and Kathisma: white cliffs and turquoise water. A full day out.

parga.title: Parga
parga.text: Valtos and Lichnos, below the Venetian castle.

preveza.title: Preveza
preveza.text: The old town and the waterfront with its tavernas, ten minutes away. Lively on summer evenings.

nikopolis.title: Ancient Nikopolis
nikopolis.text: The city Octavian founded after the Battle of Actium: walls, mosaics, a theatre and a museum.

lefkada.title: Lefkada
lefkada.text: An island you can drive to over a short bridge, with some of the best-known beaches in the Ionian.

parga.title: Parga
parga.text: A colourful harbour town under a Venetian castle, with beaches and boat trips.

gulf.title: The Ambracian Gulf
gulf.text: A calm inland sea of lagoons and wetlands, known for its dolphins and birdlife.

acheron.title: The Acheron river
acheron.text: The river of myth. Walk or wade through the gorge at its springs near Glyki.

location.tavernasEmpty: We are putting together our own list of favourite tavernas, and we share it with every guest.

gettingHere.plane: By air: Aktion airport (PVK) is about 15 minutes away, with summer flights from many European cities.
gettingHere.car: By car: about 4 hours from Athens on the Ionia Odos motorway.
gettingHere.local: A car is the easiest way to explore the area.
